assessment: A-level tool-first page for "meta description generator" (260/mo, KD 11): the Meta Tag Generator is the first screen, the 48-word answer resolves the query directly, and the body answers "meta tag generator" with first-hand AEOeye measurements before handing off to the free SEO audit.

topic.readerProblem: Someone searching "meta description generator" wants to run the check immediately and know what the result means for their site.
topic.connection: The free SEO audit runs this check site-wide (crawlability, on-page, speed, schema, HTTPS); this page is the single-URL version and links into it.

sources.supports: No limit on meta description length; snippets truncated to fit the device; description used when it describes the page better.
An invalid element in the head makes Google ignore the elements after it.
Meta recommends at least 1200x630, ~1.91:1, max 8 MB; 600x315 minimum for large cards; images cached by URL.
AEOeye 391-site baseline: redirects, headers, meta tags, OG/X tags, icons, JSON-LD, image formats, blog location, soft 404s.

checks: Re-read every factual claim against the cited primary sources, fetched on 2026-10-24 (4 sources listed on the page); unverifiable statements were removed or reworded before publishing.
content-lint passed with no errors: 375 words, 2 Pexels images, 3 inline source links, 3 internal links, 3 FAQs, 4 H2 sections.
Title/H1, secondary-keyword H2s and meta description match the locked three-round plan in docs/seo-v2/final-table.json.
Rendered on the local build at a 375 px mobile viewport: no horizontal overflow (document scrollWidth equals the viewport width).
Recomputed every figure quoted from AEOeye Technical SEO Baseline (391 sites, 2026-10-24) from the raw files in /public/resources.
Exercised the meta tag generator in the browser on the local build at desktop and 375 px widths.
